{
  "dataset_name": "bank_marketing",
  "model_family": "distance_knn",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "age_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalized age to ensure equal weighting in distance calculations.",
      "value_range": [-2.23, 5.57],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Prevents the age feature from dominating distance metrics due to its larger raw scale.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(age - 40.145) / 10.404"
    },
    {
      "name": "duration_log_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed and min-max scaled duration to compress extreme outliers and normalize the distance space.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Improves neighborhood geometry by reducing the skewness of the duration distribution.",
      "leakage_risk": "medium",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(duration) / 8.343"
    },
    {
      "name": "pdays_proximity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Converts the days since last contact into a proximity score, where 999 (never contacted) maps to 0, and recent contacts map closer to 1.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "similarity_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a continuous, meaningful similarity metric for temporal proximity, avoiding the artificial distance jump caused by the 999 placeholder.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(pdays == 999, 0.0, 1.0 / (1.0 + pdays))"
    },
    {
      "name": "engagement_centroid_distance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean distance to the mean engagement profile based on standardized campaign and previous contact frequencies.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 25.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Helps the KNN model identify individuals with highly anomalous engagement histories compared to the average population.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((campaign - 2.56) / 2.77)**2 + ((previous - 0.176) / 0.505)**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "campaign_penalty",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "A scaled penalty feature that increases linearly with the number of campaign contacts up to a threshold, then caps at 1.0.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a bounded representation of campaign intensity, preventing extreme contact counts from distorting the local neighborhood.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((campaign - 1) / 4.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "contact_frequency_similarity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute deviation of previous contacts from the mean, scaled to a 0-1 range.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "similarity_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalizes the historical contact frequency to ensure it contributes proportionally to the overall distance metric.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(previous - 0.176) / 6.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "socioeconomic_index",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "A normalized composite index combining education and job categorical encodings.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Projects discrete socioeconomic categories into a continuous, bounded space suitable for Euclidean distance calculations.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(education + job) / 18.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "time_of_year_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "A normalized temporal feature combining month and day of the week into a single 0-1 scale.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows the KNN model to compute meaningful temporal distances between different contact dates.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(month * 5 + day_of_week) / 49.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "economic_stress_prototype_distance",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Estimate the semantic distance to a prototypical high-economic-stress environment based on emp.var.rate, cons.price.idx, cons.conf.idx, and euribor3m.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Groups individuals contacted under similar macroeconomic conditions, improving the contextual relevance of nearest neighbors.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "financial_stability_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Assess the financial stability of the individual based on default, housing, and loan status, returning a continuous similarity score.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "similarity_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a dense, continuous representation of financial health, replacing sparse categorical distances.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "demographic_cluster_indicator",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Assign the individual to one of 5 demographic clusters based on age, marital status, and education to improve neighborhood grouping.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Acts as a structural prior for the KNN model, ensuring that neighbors are drawn from similar life-stage cohorts.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "engagement_prototype_distance",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Estimate the semantic distance to a prototypical high-engagement individual based on previous contact outcomes, duration, and campaign frequency.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a unified spatial dimension representing overall interaction depth, helping the model find neighbors with similar behavioral footprints.",
      "leakage_risk": "medium",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
